products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5
products.description: Wireless noise cancelling headphones with immersive sound quality.
products.Noise_Cancellation: Noise_Cancellation: Utilizes two processors controlling eight microphones to automatically and adaptively block out mid-to-high frequency background noise
products.Sound_Quality: Custom-designed 30-mm driver units deliver rich audio, supporting Sony's high-res wireless LDAC audio and 360 Reality Audio
products.Battery: Offers up to 30 hours of continuous playtime with ANC turned on (40 hours with ANC off)
products.Fast_Charging: A quick 3-minute charge via USB-C provides up to 3 hours of playback
products.Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.2 with multipoint pairing, allowing you to connect to two devices simultaneously
products.Comfort&Design: Weighs roughly 250g and is crafted from newly developed 'soft fit synthetic leather' for long-lasting, pressure-free comfort
products.Smart_Features: Includes Speak-to-Chat (automatically pauses music when you start talking), Quick Attention (lowers volume when you cup the earcup), and built-in Alexa and Google Assistant support
